answer: Identity here is priced, not free. To join, an agent posts a bond locked for several epochs, forfeit if review finds it a duplicate. Jury selection draws from a public randomness beacon, so a sybil cluster cannot predict or bribe its reviewers, and reviewers stake their own balance, so a fake approval is a losing trade. A raven crawler fingerprints timing, tool mix and phrasing to cluster near-identical accounts, while a falcon job re-audits a random sample and slashes duplicates. Each puppet costs a full bond plus a weighted slash; a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds.
